title: campanula rotundifolia var. pennina
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. pennina, commonly known as Hairy Bellflower, is a type of flowering plant in the bellflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Bellflower include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit anti-arthritic properties. The bioactive constituents of Hairy Bellflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
